login.chittiHi: Hi! I'm CHITTI, your learning buddy. Ready to explore?
login.heroTitle2: A school portal that feels like an adventure
login.heroBody2: Learn with CHITTI, earn badges, grow your brain power, and keep everyone connected: students, teachers, parents and admins.

welcome.0: Every day is a new opportunity to learn!
welcome.2: Small steps every day make big dreams come true.
welcome.3: Mistakes are proof that you are trying. Keep going!
welcome.4: Ask questions. Smart people always do.
welcome.5: Today is a great day to discover something new.
welcome.6: You are braver than you think and smarter than you know.
welcome.streak: Wow, a {{n}}-day streak! You're on fire! 🔥

chitti.sub: Your friendly AI buddy. Type or speak in any language!
chitti.parentSub: Understand your child's lessons, in your language.
chitti.teacherSub: Lesson plans, revision material and quick answers.
chitti.attach: Attach a photo, PDF or notes
chitti.placeholder: Ask anything… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
chitti.safety: CHITTI can make mistakes. It prefers your school's material and says 'I'm not sure' when unsure. Chats are visible to teachers for safety.
chitti.consentBody: Ask your parent to switch on CHITTI from the Parent portal. Then we can learn together!
chitti.topicPlaceholder: Type a topic: photosynthesis, fractions, Mars…
chitti.videoNote: Links open YouTube search results. Watch with a grown-up nearby.

hello.study_buddy: Hi! What shall we learn today? Ask me to explain anything, step by step.
hello.doubt_solver: Stuck on a question? Type it (or attach a photo) and I'll solve it step by step.
hello.english: Let's practise English! Write a sentence and I'll help you make it shine.
hello.aptitude: Ready for some brain-sharpening? Give me a reasoning or number problem.
hello.career: Curious about what you could become? Let's explore together.
hello.parent: Namaste! Ask me about what your child is learning, and I'll explain it simply with home activity ideas.
hello.lesson_plan: Hello teacher! Tell me the class, subject and topic, and I'll draft a lesson plan or question set.

english: i goes to school by bus
career: How do I become a scientist?
parent: How can I help with fractions at home?

photo.title: Snap a doubt
photo.sub: Take a photo of a textbook or notebook question. CHITTI reads it and solves it step by step.
photo.empty: Your step-by-step solution will appear here.

practice.good: Nice work! A little more practice and you'll master it.
practice.tryAgain: Good effort! Read the explanations and try again.
practice.none: No practice questions for this one yet.

game.title: Knowledge Adventure
game.freezeHelp: Streak savers: miss one day and your streak is safe. Earn one every 7 days.
game.mysterySub: 3 surprise questions. Open once a day!
game.worldsSub: Earn XP in each subject to unlock stages. Beat a boss challenge for big rewards!
game.bossTry: Great try! Every attempt makes you stronger.
game.bossDoneToday: You already beat this boss today. Play for practice!
game.lbPrivacy: Only students who choose to appear are shown ({{n}} kept private). Teams always count everyone's effort.
game.shopSub: Spend knowledge coins on fun looks for your buddy.
game.realWorldSub: Fun things to try away from the screen, with family and friends.

shapes.title: Shape hunt
shapes.body: Find 10 shapes at home: circles, triangles, cubes… Draw them!

teach.title: Be the teacher
teach.body: Teach a family member one thing you learnt today.

measure.title: Footstep maths
measure.body: Measure your room in footsteps, then in centimetres. Compare!

plant.title: Grow a seed
plant.body: Plant a seed and record its height every day for a week.

story.title: Story swap
story.body: Ask a grandparent for a story from their childhood. Retell it in English.

kindness.title: Secret kindness
kindness.body: Do something kind without being asked. Notice how it feels.

recycle.title: Waste detective
recycle.body: Sort one day's waste at home into wet, dry and recyclable.

stars.title: Sky watcher
stars.body: Look at the night sky. Can you spot the Moon's shape and a bright planet?

brain.title: Brain Gym
brain.sub: Fun puzzles that grow 8 thinking skills. Puzzles get harder as you improve!
brain.notIq: This is a Learning Growth Score that shows practice and progress. It is not an IQ test and never labels anyone.

eng.title: English Chitti
eng.sub: Speak, write and shine! Friendly feedback on grammar, words and fluency.
eng.private: Private: only you see your practice.
eng.noMic: Voice isn't available in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge, or type instead.
eng.question: Interview question
eng.writeHint: Write a few sentences about your day…
eng.pronScore: You got {{n}}% of the words clear!
eng.waiting: Speak or write something, and CHITTI will help you improve it.

career.title: Career & Innovation Lab
career.sub: Explore interests, try STEM activities, code, and find scholarships.
career.note: These are directions to explore, not predictions. Interests grow and change. Talk to your teachers and family!
career.scholarEmpty: Fill in your details to see matching scholarships.
career.noMatch: No demo matches. Check the official portal for more.

lib.title: Library
lib.sub: Syllabus, notes, textbooks, previous papers, e-books and videos, all in one place.
lib.aiSub: Key points and a mind-map of this chapter.
lib.uploadHint: PDF text is split into chapters automatically ("Chapter 1 …" headings or pages). Students in that class will see it.
lib.subject: Subject
lib.textHint: Paste notes here. Use 'Chapter 1 …' lines to split chapters.
lib.fileHint: PDF, text, image (OCR) or audio. Max 8 MB.

msg.title: Messages
msg.sub: Chat with your teachers, students or parents.

forum.title: Doubt board
forum.sub: Ask doubts, share ideas and help classmates. Teachers keep it friendly.
forum.empty: No posts yet. Be the first!
forum.kindRule: Be kind. Explain, don't just give answers.

counsel.title: Talk to someone
counsel.sub: A safe, private space to share worries or complaints with the school counsellor.
counsel.hug: Whatever you're feeling is okay. A trained counsellor will read and reply.
counsel.privacy: Only the school's counsellors can read this. Not your classmates, and not other teachers.
counsel.urgent: If you feel unsafe right now, tell a trusted adult immediately, or call Childline 1098 (India, free, 24×7).
counsel.inboxSub: Private messages from students. Reply with care.
counsel.notCounsellor: Only staff marked as counsellors (by the admin) can open this inbox.

proj.title: Project space
proj.sub: Build cool things together and show off your achievements.
proj.name: Project name

port.empty: Add certificates, sports, art and more.

grow.title: Personal growth
grow.sub: Reflect, be kind, make good choices. Every small step counts.
grow.private: Private and voluntary. Nobody grades this.
grow.missionsSub: Tiny challenges for confidence, kindness and teamwork.
grow.talk: Something worrying you? You can always talk to a counsellor.

prompt.learned: What is one new thing you learnt today?
prompt.kind: What kind thing did you do or see today?
prompt.tricky: What was tricky today, and how did you handle it?
prompt.grateful: Name three things you are grateful for.
prompt.tomorrow: What is one small goal for tomorrow?

mission.help_home: Help with a chore at home
mission.new_word: Learn and use a new word

exhibition.q: Science exhibition tomorrow, and your teammate hasn't done their part. What do you do?
exhibition.talk: Talk to them kindly and ask what's wrong
exhibition.do_all: Do everything myself and stay angry
exhibition.tell_teacher: Complain to the teacher right away
exhibition.why: Talking first and sharing the work keeps the team strong. Ask the teacher for help if it still doesn't work.

left_out.q: A new student sits alone at lunch every day. What do you do?
left_out.invite: Invite them to join your group
left_out.tell_later: Mention it to someone next month
left_out.why: A small invitation can change someone's whole day.

exam_stress.q: Exams are in 3 days and you feel panicky. What's best?
exam_stress.plan_breaks: Make a plan with short breaks and sleep
exam_stress.ask_help: Ask a teacher or parent for help
exam_stress.why: Rest and a simple plan help your brain remember more. Asking for help is smart.

found_wallet.q: You find a wallet in the school corridor. What do you do?
found_wallet.give_office: Give it to the school office
found_wallet.spend: Spend a little and return it
found_wallet.why: Honesty builds trust. The office can find the owner.

bus.title: My school bus
bus.sub: Live bus location and arrival time at your stop.
bus.noVehicle: No vehicle on this route yet.

ins.title: Class insights
ins.sub: Where your students need support, and what to reteach.
ins.aiSub: Questions students asked CHITTI (for safety oversight). Answers are not stored here.
ins.revMade: Draft revision quiz with {{n}} questions created. Review and publish it.
ins.kindNote: Signals suggest who might need a friendly check-in. They are never labels about ability.

si.title: School intelligence
si.sub: Data-driven decisions with kind, practical interventions.
si.demoNote: Demo school: the numbers come from illustrative seed data.
si.patternsSub: Automatically spotted trends. Each comes with a supportive next step.

pattern.stopped_quizzes: {{count}} student(s) in {{section}} haven't taken a quiz in 2 weeks.
pattern.attendance_performance: In {{section}}, students who miss school score {{gap}} points lower on quizzes.

action.attendance_drive: Call parents of frequent absentees and celebrate improved attendance.
action.remedial_sessions: Plan short remedial sessions and practice quizzes.
action.gentle_checkin: Class teacher: a gentle check-in to see if something is in the way.
action.attendance_buddy: Pair absentees with a study buddy and share notes.
action.celebrate: Celebrate their effort in assembly or the class group.
action.subject_review: Review pacing with the subject team; add visual activities.
action.reteach: Reteach with a new approach, then use the revision-quiz button.

tr.title: Transport
tr.sub: Routes, buses and stops. Parents and students see live location.
tr.stopsHint: One per line: name, latitude, longitude, minutes from start
tr.gpsHint: A GPS device posts to /api/transport/vehicles/{id}/location with header X-Device-Token. Without it, the position is simulated from the timetable.

safe.title: Safety & audit
safe.sub: Who did what, who can read counselling messages, and how CHITTI is used.
safe.counsellorsSub: Only these staff can read the counselling inbox.

ph.hello: Here's how your children are doing today. Ask CHITTI anything about their lessons!
ph.leaveSub: Just write a message. We'll fill the form for you, and the class teacher decides.
ph.leaveExample: e.g. My child will not attend tomorrow due to a family function
ph.neverAuto: This is a request. It is not approved until the class teacher approves it. You'll be notified.
ph.consentSub: Allow your child to use the CHITTI AI tutor. You can change this any time.
ph.chittiSub: Get today's lesson explained simply, with home activity ideas.

pp.englishPrivate: Practice text is private to your child.
pp.careerNone: Your child hasn't taken the interest quiz yet.

notif.counselling_new: 💗 A student sent a counselling message.
notif.leave_parent_message: Leave note from parent for {{name}} ({{from}} to {{to}}). Pending with the class teacher.

talk.title: Talk with CHITTI
talk.sub: Speak naturally. CHITTI listens, thinks and talks back, like a phone call.
talk.typeHere: Type a message and press Enter…
talk.noHear: I couldn't hear you. Tap “Start talking” to try again.
talk.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access from the browser address bar, then try again.
talk.unsupported: This browser can't listen yet. Please use Chrome or Edge, or type your message.
talk.noSpeaker: This browser can't speak replies aloud. You can still read them.
talk.error: Sorry, I couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
talk.tip: Tip: use Chrome or Edge in a quiet room and speak in {{lang}}. Change the language from the top bar.

palette.title: Colour theme
palette.hint: Your choice is saved on this device.
